title: Properties of Air and Water
ques: Can you see air? How do you know that it is all around you?

answer.content: No, you cannot see air because it is invisible. However, you know it is there because you can feel it blowing as wind, you can see trees moving when it pushes them, and you breathe it in every day.

explanation: This exercise helps students understand the invisible but physical nature of air.

title: Weather Changes
ques: What should you wear outside if you look out the window and see dark gray clouds and puddles on the ground?

answer.content: You should wear a raincoat, rubber boots, and take an umbrella because dark clouds and puddles mean it is rainy weather.

explanation: This tests basic weather observation and practical decision-making.

title: Importance of Clean Water
ques: Why is it important to drink clean water instead of water from a muddy puddle?

answer.content: It is important to drink clean water because dirty or muddy water can contain germs and dirt that will make you sick. Clean water helps keep your body healthy and strong.

explanation: This exercise connects the concept of purity with personal health and hygiene.
